sn31.2:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn31.2:1.3: ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā gandhabbakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn31.2:1.4: idha bhikkhu, ekacco kāyena sucaritaṃ carati, vācāya sucaritaṃ carati, manasā sucaritaṃ carati.
sn31.2:1.8: “aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā gandhabbakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya”nti.
sn31.2:1.9: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā gandhabbakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
sn31.2:1.10: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā gandhabbakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
